meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: Claude会组建一个安全研究团队，包含3名漏洞猎人和2名PoC工程师，并行审计代码库，查找漏洞，验证其可利用性，分类成因，并根据实际可利用性评估严重等级。
howto.when: 当你说出“security-research”、“security review”、“vulnerability audit”等关键词，或要求进行安全审计、漏洞分析时触发。

say.text: 对这个代码库进行安全性审计。
检查当前分支与上游的差异中有没有安全漏洞。
验证这个功能的可利用性。

howto.what_en: Claude assembles a security research team of 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit code in parallel, find vulnerabilities, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity based on actual exploitability.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'security-research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit' or similar keywords, or request a security audit.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on this repository.
say_en.note: Claude will launch the team and start the audit.

say_en.text: Check the current branch diff for vulnerabilities.

say_en.note: PoC engineers will try to reproduce.
